title: introduce-ci-lite-bootstrapper-and-toolcache-proxy-to-shrink-presubmit-setup
author: Asha K. Patel
description: Motivation: reduce presubmit setup time and CI flakiness by consolidating multiple heavy init scripts into a tiny Go-based bootstrapper (ci-lite) and introducing a local toolcache proxy to avoid repeated remote package downloads. This PR moves language-specific toolchain setup into a shared cache primed by the proxy and fences noisy initializers behind an opt-in presubmit profile. Implementation details: - add cmd/ci-lite (Go) that acts as a compact init runner and env validator - introduce internal/toolcache/proxy service (lightweight HTTP cache with TTL and ETag support) - wire ci-lite into GitHub Actions presubmit job templates (fastpath lane) - add metrics emission (reduced, opt-in) and a CI flag to enable full telemetry - update developer docs and devcontainer to use local cache when present Rollout plan: 1) feature branch and opt-in for small teams; 2) enable for fastpath lanes; 3) monitor cache hit-rate and presubmit latency; 4) gradually make default for monorepo. Backwards compatibility: existing heavy init remains available via legacy job with deprecation notice.
commits: Introduce toolcache proxy service and tests
Add docs for toggling telemetry and proxy usage
Fix tests: adjust integration mocks for proxy TTL
review_comments: Diego Ramos: Overall good direction — can you split the proxy concerns and runner to independent packages? The proxy currently embeds fetch logic that we'd prefer decoupled. Small nit on log verbosity.
Asha K. Patel: responded — split proxy fetch into fetcher.go, added interface and unit tests. Reduced logs in ci-lite and added -verbose flag.
Marta Voss: CI template edit: rework to use matrix.excludes to avoid duplication. Also request to gate metrics behind CI flag by default.
Keita Saito: Approved after green CI. Noted flake on integration test under arm runners; suggested retry strategy in proxy.
Automated reviewer (deps-bot): dependency bump: github.com/fastcache v1.2.0 -> v1.3.1; lockfile updated.
discussion_resolution: Addressed: proxy fetch decoupled, verbose logs trimmed, metrics flag defaulted to off, added retry/backoff for arm runners. Left follow-ups: enable full telemetry after 2 weeks of metrics review and add RBAC to proxy for private installers.
release_notes: Introduce ci-lite Go bootstrapper and a local toolcache proxy to reduce presubmit setup time and CI network I/O. Fastpath presubmit lane can opt-in to the new lightweight init. Telemetry for this flow is opt-in and disabled by default. Follow-up tasks: monitor cache hit rate and enable telemetry for high-traffic repos.
notes: Performance numbers observed in internal canary: median presubmit setup dropped from ~95s to ~28s on warm cache; cold-cache first run ~120s due to proxy priming. Toolcache hit-rate averaged 78% after one week in fastpath opt-ins.
